presetCoverageHint: These funnels include collected data that can be linked to the same operation. Missing historical observations do not imply drop-off or task failure.
presetFunnelsHint: Choose a feature to measure entry, submission, backend acceptance, success and result viewing along the same operation chain within seven days. Production excludes internal accounts by default; staging includes them. Native traffic filters do not apply to these presets. Each query supports at most 93 calendar days.
title: Business analytics
subtitle: Task records and consumption ledger, queried directly from Novix.
comparison: This page displays the selected main range. Comparison is configured on the Swetrix source page.
token_available: All token fields have been reported for every consumption record.
token_partial: Partial coverage. Totals include reported values only.
token_unavailable: Token data is unavailable for this range.
taskDefinition: Tasks include all records created in the selected period, grouped by their current raw status. finish is the stored task state.
creditDefinition: Credits use consume ledger records by actual ledger date. Zero-credit and missing-task records remain in the denominator.
limitations: The resource section queries the original ledger directly. Product panels use accepted operations, current account classification and recorded lifecycle times.
empty: No task or consumption records in this range.
error_401: Your session has expired. Sign in to Swetrix to continue.
error_403: You do not have access to this private project's business statistics.
error_404: This project has no configured business analytics binding.
error_422: Choose valid dates, a supported timezone and a range of up to 93 calendar days.
error_429: Statistics are busy. Try again shortly.
error_503: Business statistics are not enabled or are temporarily unavailable.
error_504: Statistics timed out. Try a shorter range.
error_generic: Business statistics could not be loaded. Try again.
error_product_analytics_capacity_exceede: This report exceeds the query budget. Choose a shorter date range.
filterPartial: Some identity or filter fields lack a recorded association. Read affected metrics with their coverage information.
trafficScope: PV and UV describe overall product traffic. The feature filter applies to accepted usage, retention and task outcomes.
registrationScope: Registrations use the date and account filter. Other filters apply to product usage.
averageEngaged: Seconds per session with engagement data
retentionDefinition: D0 is the first accepted use across retained history. Exact-day and cumulative return are separate. Only complete target days enter the denominator.
acceptedCohortStatuses: Operations accepted in the selected interval: current status
eventsInRange: Terminal events occurring in the selected interval
durationAndInFlight: Accepted-cohort duration and all current in-flight operations
successDefinition: finish counts as success for text and file tasks. Cancelled and active tasks are listed separately. Timed metrics require an actual completion timestamp.
funnelDefinition: Each stage requires one correlated operation chain within seven days of entry. Account switches preserve separate identities.
identityCoverage: Anonymous traffic may have unknown internal-account status. Anonymous history before a page reload remains separate unless an explicit identity link exists.
resourceOverview: Raw task records and resource ledger
resourceScope: This section uses the date range and includes all account classifications. Product filters apply to the product panels above.
versionHint: Choose a feature to filter its versions
partialResources: Resource statistics are temporarily unavailable. Other panels remain available.
